headline: Daily African financial markets: at the BRVM, selling pressure prevails
summary: Selling pressure outweighed buying on the BRVM regional exchange, according to the daily review of African financial markets.
why: The BRVM is the regional stock exchange for several West African francophone countries, and its moves reflect investor sentiment in the region.
original_headline: La quotidienne des marchés financiers africains : à la BRVM, la pression vendeuse l’emporte
